title: Any light script (khas, casper gaming or victor) compatible with Mode 7 script?

posts.author: Intruder
posts.body:
I was recently trying to experiment with a script I found out there called "mode 7" by the user "MGC" and after testing it, I thought it would be great to see if it was compatible with any rpg maker vx ace light script, the thing is that when trying the first two that I mention in the title, for some reason when activating mode 7, the lights stay flat, as if they do not "lean" with the other things on the map, they act as if the map were still 2d, is there any way to make this work?
the mode 7 script:
[RPG-MAKER.FR] Scripts - Mode 7 (Semi-3D)
Tout l'univers de RPG Maker en français! Des jeux, des tutos, des ressources, et l'actualité de la scène francophone et étrangère.
